paper_title: Low-Energy Supernovae Severely Constrain Radiative Particle Decays
notes: Astrophysical bound from low-energy supernovae calorimetry constraining ALP-photon coupling via a->2gamma radiative decays depositing energy in the progenitor star (Emantle < 0.1 B, R*=5e13 cm reference contour, Fig. 2). Excluded region spans ma ~1-500 MeV, G_agamma ~1e-10 to 1e-8 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate lower (weakest-coupling) boundary of the closed exclusion contour read from Fig. 2; the region is bounded above near the trapping regime (~1e-8 to 1e-7). Not a DM haloscope, so no local density. This is a stellar/astrophysical bound, not a coupling-in-fa-plane result, hence AxionPhoton not AxionMass. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 7))
